roadmap.title: An animal that is following you goes through a portal
roadmap.body:
Vanilla leaves every tamed animal on the wrong side of a portal, and that is the one place leading one stops being worth doing. A boar will follow you anywhere you like; it is the walk home that turns a pen into a project.

So an animal you have told to follow goes through with you, and only a following one. One you left staying stays where it is, so the gesture the mod is about, Alt+E, is also the only control there is.

This is the one place Taum gets wider rather than narrower, and that is worth saying out loud because the rest of the mod is deliberately the other way. Following was never meant to solve transport. A portal makes it a long move that costs nothing, and whether that is too much is the question this line is still open on.

It does not touch the ore rule. Metal still cannot go through a portal, and an animal carrying nothing is not a loophole in that.

roadmap.title: Hover text that says following or staying
roadmap.body: The hover on a tamed boar or hen only offers Alt+E to toggle. It should also say which one the animal is doing now, so you know what pressing will do. The state is the game's own, read off the animal.
